title: Jonah and the Asset
author: Paloma Halloran
blurb: Oscar Pemberton, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
